# DockMagic 1.2

## What's new

- Capture screenshots from your Dock and edit them with blur, arrows, text, drawing, highlights, and presentation backgrounds.
- Record a display, window, or selected area with optional system audio and microphone input.
- Add service-status Widgets for Codex and Claude Code, plus more detailed AI usage charts and activity history.
- Expand Cloudflare monitoring with Health, Errors, Threats, Protection, Alerts, and Vitals Widgets, and add certificate details to website monitoring.
- Organize Gmail with Needs You, 7-Day Priority, and VIP Widgets, including local follow-up reminders.
- Improve Pomodoro with flexible and strict focus sessions, away detection, Focus Shield, and daily activity details.
- Refine onboarding, Widget selection, Dock resizing, popup focus, and Google and Cloudflare account connections.
- Add feedback in Settings and improve license activation and pricing information.

## Compatibility and installation

- Requires macOS 14.0 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
- Existing users can enable Check for Update in Settings to install this release.
- For a manual installation, download the disk image and drag DockMagic into Applications.
- Screen capture requires the relevant macOS permission; microphone recording requires Microphone permission.
- AI usage requires the corresponding Claude or Codex tools and an authenticated local account. Google and Cloudflare integrations require account authorization; available Cloudflare data depends on account permissions and plan.
- License activation and verification require an internet connection.

# DockMagic 1.0

The first release of DockMagic, an independent Widget Dock for macOS.

## Features

- Place your DockMagic Dock at the bottom, left, or right of a display.
- Choose, arrange, resize, and customize Widgets for system activity, network traffic, batteries, sound, clocks, calendars, Gmail, and power controls.
- Link Google accounts to read Gmail through read-only Widgets and a message popup.
- Use the free Widget selection or activate a lifetime license for additional styles.
- Enable Check for Update in Settings to receive future releases.

## Compatibility and installation

- Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
- Download the disk image, open it, and drag DockMagic into Applications.
- Launch DockMagic from Applications. Settings, Show Dock, and Quit are available from its menu bar icon.
- Gmail requires Google authorization. Calendar and other protected features request their relevant macOS permissions.
- License activation and verification require an internet connection.
